_comment: support-ticket workflow — statewright MachineDefinition encoding the shipped jira-ticket FSM. Authored 2026-09-11 for OpenSpec change statewright-workflow-layer, task 3.1. Sources of truth: docs/statewright/cheatsheet.md (shape) and docs/statewright/jira-ticket-fsm.md (state + transition extraction). Human gates (task 3.2) and JSON Schema (task 3.3) are layered on separately.

discover.instructions: One-time per-ticket setup: create try dir, seed Dust conversation, jiraai-review dump (ticket.md + related.md), extract related MRs, claim herdr tab, stamp bead DAG via beads-decompose. Read-only w.r.t. code; may mutate the try dir and beads DB.

RELATED_MR_OPT_IN.approval_message: Opt in to watch a related MR? (parallel observation lane, one bead per URL)

set_capability.instructions: Write customfield_11907 (PLAT Platform Capability) via jiraai-edit. Independent of the code-fix lane but blocks close/archive. Auto-skips to explore if jira-pick already set it upstream.

explore.instructions: Read-only fact gathering. Reproduce the bug, write proof.md with a verified repro and a root-cause hypothesis. NO mutations: no apply / patch / mr create / bd close.

propose_fix.instructions: Design the smallest correct fix. Enumerate at least 2 alternatives. Run Dust rounds (prior art + sanity). Write fix.md. NO code writes yet: no editor, no git commit, no MR ops.

OPERATOR_APPROVES_FIX_MD.approval_message: Approve fix.md design and unlock implementation?

fix.instructions: Approval-gate alias. Pause point between propose_fix and implement. No tools invoked; the operator OK IS the implementation-start signal.

implement.instructions: Code the fix in the worktree. Commit with commit-rationale. Open the MR via glab-mr-open (the ONLY sanctioned MR-creation path). Run the mandatory glab-mr-ready probe. Iterate on red rows.

MR_OPENED.approval_message: Human review of the implementation complete; hand off to CI?

ci_green.instructions: Wait for the head pipeline to reach 'success'. Poll via glab-mr-ready. Arm async-wait on watch:pipeline=<id>. On failure, hand back to fix.

PIPELINE_FAILED.approval_message: CI pipeline failed; re-enter fix loop? (retry after pipeline red)

review.instructions: Assign reviewers via glab-mr-assign (verified usernames + '+'-add). Post @mention on the Jira ticket. Loop on unresolved discussion threads until approvals are green.

merge.instructions: Re-probe with glab-mr-ready. Merge with squash + remove-source-branch. Verify state == merged and merge_commit_sha != null. On merge_error, hand back to review.

MR_MERGED.approval_message: MR merged; cut a tag (skip if repo is not tag-managed)?

tag.instructions: Detect tag-management (.releaserc*, .goreleaser.*, recent semver, release CI job). Cut the tag OR skip-close if the repo is not tag-managed.

deploy_dev.instructions: Fire the dev deploy job (Spinak manual play / Argo sync / Terraform noop). Write deploy.md with rollback command. Arm async-wait on watch:pipeline=<id> or watch:rollout=<ns/deploy>.

verify_dev.instructions: Run the jira-monitor tactic menu (pup / kubectl / aws / dig / curl). 1200s baseline wait is skippable in dev per operator preference. Rollup GREEN / YELLOW / RED.

VERIFY_RED.approval_message: verify_dev RED; re-enter fix loop? (retry after pipeline red)

deploy_staging.instructions: Same shape as deploy_dev, targeting staging. Arm async-wait on the staging pipeline / rollout.

verify_staging.instructions: Same tactic menu as verify_dev, targeting staging. 1200s baseline wait is skippable per operator preference.

VERIFY_GREEN.approval_message: Staging verified GREEN; unlock the prod deploy gate?

VERIFY_RED.approval_message: verify_staging RED; re-enter fix loop? (retry after pipeline red)

deploy_prod.instructions: HARD MANUAL GATE. Never auto-fires even when staging is green. The bead carries blocking:human; the operator drops it by typing 'deploy prod'. Then fire the prod deploy job and arm async-wait.

OPERATOR_DEPLOYS_PROD.approval_message: HARD MANUAL GATE — type 'deploy prod' to fire the prod deploy job.

verify_prod.instructions: MANDATORY 1200s baseline wait — NOT skippable. Same tactic menu. RED → fix (operator rollback). GREEN → answer.

VERIFY_GREEN.approval_message: Prod verified GREEN after 1200s baseline; start drafting the reporter reply?

VERIFY_RED.approval_message: verify_prod RED; operator rollback and re-enter fix loop? (retry after pipeline red)

answer.instructions: Calibrate PLAT voice (last 3 close-outs → voice.md). Draft answer.md in ONE of {Fixed, In flight, Won't fix, Need info}. Run mandatory Dust review (accuracy + tone). Do NOT post without explicit operator OK.

OPERATOR_APPROVES_ANSWER_MD.approval_message: Approve answer.md before posting to the reporter?

close.instructions: Post the reply via jiraai-comment. Transition ticket to Done via jiraai-edit — REFUSES if customfield_11907 (capability) is empty. On 'Need more info' shape, transition to Waiting-for-customer and go to awaiting_reporter.

POSTED_NEED_INFO.approval_message: Pause for the reporter — enter awaiting_reporter (Waiting-for-customer)?

POSTED_AND_DONE.approval_message: Final Done transition — archive the ticket?

awaiting_reporter.instructions: Only entered when close posted a 'Need more info' reply. Ticket status is Waiting-for-customer. ScheduleWakeup 1800s, re-armed up to 24h cap. On reporter reply, transition back to In-Progress and re-enter explore. On 24h cap, operator picks won't-fix close.

archive.instructions: Terminal. jiraai-edit Done already fired in close; DOD spot-check confirmed. Bead loop exited; herdr tab closed.

watch_related_mr.instructions: Parallel opt-in lane. One bead per URL from related-mrs.txt. Poll the watched MR via glab; on merged, operator decides whether the adjacent fix collapses our own lane.
